newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Talbert Medical Q2 shr loss $3.15.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Talbert Medical Q2 shr loss $3.15.

text.p: (amounts in thousands, except per share and membership data)
Weighted avg. number of common shares and common equivalent

NOTE: The company reported a loss before income taxes of $9.7 million on revenue of $101.8 million for the second quarter of 1997 compared with 1996 loss before income taxes of $2.8 million on revenue of $119.1 million.

The company said that if results for the second quarter of 1996 were restated on a pro forma basis to reflect the revised capitation rates that took effect March 1, 1997, it would have reported a loss before income taxes of about $14.4 million on revenue of about $109.3 million.
The pro forma adjustment reflects the impact of new provider agreements covering FHP/PacifiCare capitated enrollees.
The company's full name is Talbert Medical Management Holdings Corp.
